title: Holes don't align for correct assembly.
text:
Holes don't align for correct assembly.. May I just say how much I absolutely detest all Allen wrenches projects?? This little table is very pretty and is exactly the correct dimensions for a tiny space in the master closet. Unfortunately, because the legs and bottom shelf require Allen wrench screws, it takes much longer to put together than it should.

This is further compounded by two legs with misaligned holes - the bolts literally cannot go into the top holes on either leg. So we had to find the drill and create new holes and sort of jimmy everything together. It worked, but the quality control is in need of improvement before these tables ever reach the customers.
